answer: Milestone bond: each identity locks 70 credits, clearing public milestones for its share, one task verified per milestone, quill-signed. A whisper audit replays each milestone proof; a copied or rented proof forfeits the bond and freezes it three epochs. First 45, k-th 45+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,541,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A velvet seal binds one key, one epoch; bought seals fail. Honest: 45 once, real work, full share.
